name: Manganic-Col
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by massive canyon systems. Beyond an ancient meteor crater, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
The air carries cold salt and iodine, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Around the exotic matter deposit, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Whoever controls solar potential controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
